title: Diversify within each class
objectives: Explain why diversifying across asset classes is not enough.
Give an example of diversification inside equity and inside debt.
body_md:
Mixing asset classes is the first layer. The second is diversifying inside each class.

## Inside equity

Across company sizes and styles: large, mid and small cap; growth and value; index and active. Ten mid-cap funds holding the same stocks is not diversification, it is the same bet with more paperwork.

## Inside debt

Across issuers and maturities. A portfolio of one corporate issuer's paper is a credit bet, not a stable part of the mix. Short-duration, gilt and target-maturity funds do different jobs.

## Inside gold and cash

Gold through an ETF, a fund or SGBs already held; cash across a savings account and a liquid fund. Overlap here is harmless, but there is no benefit in holding four gold funds.

## The test

If two holdings would fall for the same reason, they are one holding. Count them that way.
example: A client holds five flexi-cap funds from five AMCs. The top ten stocks overlap by more than half, so the five funds behave like one large position with five expense ratios.
say: Within equity, let's spread across sizes and styles, not just across fund houses.
If two funds fall for the same reason, they are one holding.
never: Debt funds from three AMCs diversify credit risk.

talk_track.title: Diversify within each class too
talk_track.text: Remember to diversify within each class too: equity across company sizes and styles, and debt across issuers and maturities. Several funds holding the same stocks are not diversification; they are the same bet with more paperwork.

check.q: A client holds five flexi-cap funds with heavily overlapping portfolios. What is true?
o: That is good diversification across AMCs
They behave like one holding, with five expense ratios
check.why: If two holdings fall for the same reason, they are one holding. Diversify across sizes and styles instead.

check.q: How do you diversify inside debt?
o: By holding only one gilt fund
check.why: Debt is diversified across issuers and maturities, which spreads credit and interest-rate risk.

check.q: Which is NOT a way to diversify inside equity?
o: Across styles such as growth and value
Across five copies of the same flexi-cap fund
check.why: Overlapping funds are the same bet. Sizes, styles and index versus active are real dimensions.
